reviews.text: Great service with bathing and grooming, super friendly and attentive staff too. My dog even gets excited to go in every time. Best grooming service in the area!

We visited Palace Pet Grooming again and I'm so happy with Coco's haircut! This time we decided on a different style than usual and we were very pleased with the result. He looks beautiful. The staff was very friendly and attentive, and you can tell how much love and care they give to the pets. We'll definitely be back. Thank you for everything! 🤗

First time bringing Luka in and I was very happy. They treated him with care and professionalism; he came out looking impeccable and happy, which is what matters most.  Also, when I mentioned that he’s afraid of the blow dryer, they went the extra mile and covered his ears to keep him calm. You can really see the dedication and love they have for what they do. I will definitely be back. 100% recommended!
I love this place. I feel so good about the way they handle my dog. Thank you!
My furbaby is older and needed a gentle hand with patience. They took very good care of her and she came out looking adorable! Definitely recommend them!
Always professional and friendly. We’ve been bringing our Shih Tzu here for 7 years now.
Super nice people, they are very kind and gentle twords my pet I Reccomnd this place my dog always leaves smelling good
Tooked my Yorkie for a haircut.  His hair cut came out really terrible even left him with a whole around his neck didn't notice at first until I got home.  Super unhappy do not recommend
I was delighted with the service and how they did my dog. I loved her haircut and the attention was excellent. I highly recommend it! 😍😍😍 …

I can’t say enough great things about this groomer! They are hands down the best! The best prices, super friendly staff, and they always do an incredible job.  You can tell they truly care about the pets they work with, and the attention to detail is unmatched. Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality grooming and genuinely kind people!
Thanks Sebastian. See you soon to pamper your furry friend,
Thanks Lissette always welcome.
Always nice and friendly service.  My dog has never looked or smelled better!

Owners are very nice and try to accommodate when possible. They deliver grooming style as per customer request, which I value, and pricing is definitely competitive! My goldendoodle is now 3 months shy of her 3rd birthday, and it took me 2 whole years and many groomers to finally find groomers that I’m happy to stick with! I’m not difficult by any means, but like things to be done well, and I very highly recommend them!
I loved everything, excellent service, my dog ​​looks perfect, thank you so much for everything
They provide amazing service plus the groomers know their skills. My dogs have never looked better since I started coming to Palace Grooming.

Excellent place, they're very considerate of the dogs and leave them clean and beautiful.
I highly recommend it.

My experience is always excellent, and they're always available when I call without an appointment. My dogs always look beautiful. Everyone is great, but the gentleman is the friendliest! Thank you all for making my dogs look brand new ❤️
The best groomer in Kendall. I’ve been taking my dog there for years, never disappoint. They always make sure to accommodate my dog whenever I call, and they take good care of him. Love them!

I love how they take care of my puppy.
They are so nice and gentle that i wouldn’t go anywhere else!
Great service. They are super friendly and very professional. I took my Goldendoodle for a grooming, and he came out looking perfectly groomed and happy :)
Excellent place, my pet looked beautiful! I highly recommend it!

I have been bringing my dog here since she was 4 months old and Esther, Alvaro, and the entire staff have always done a wonderful job in taking care of her. They are always very accommodating when making an appointment, they offer lots of services, and are very nice!
I would recommend Palace Pet Grooming & Boutique 100% if you have a fur baby!
Excellent work, there's nothing better than having your dog cared for as if it were their own.
Thanks for your stars

Highly recommended service.
Malak is happy coming here and looks amazing.
They took care of my Frankie with care. He looked great! Would definitely recommend!!
The only place I ever take my dog to get groomed. They always do a great job and leave him smelling super good!
Amazing staff and quick! We love them
So professional and welcoming! Always feels like home as a family member is taking care of her!

I brought in my puppy for the first time and they did an amazing job. He came in and got a full groom for an affordable price. I definitely will be returning monthly!

Update: It’s been over a year, and I continue bringing my dog here. The staff is amazing, my dog always feels safe, and I never have to worry about him. The prices are still great, and the results are consistently excellent. Overall, I recommend this place to everyone — definitely the best grooming spot in Miami!
We loved it, they are very friendly and my baby was delighted, and the price is very affordable.
Such a loving environment my pups always feel good going there and come out looking beautiful.
Best place to my little peluda
Excellent service and they really love my dog. I highly recommend them.
Very good

I have been coming here for over 7 years, amazing staff!
Amazing service always!
Great job done for my dogs today
Nice and friendly place to groom, but my dog had a bad experience this time. He gets back to me with wounds and he felt really bad.

Palace Gromers are the only place I will take my fur-babies.  They are very nice and accommodating.  I have a very fussy and feisty little Maltese and they treat her with so much love and she always comes home looking like a princess.  My PomPom comes home looking like a prince.  They always do a great job.  I will only take my pups to them.  They’re great!
I'm very happy with the way they treat my pet, and they always accommodate my requests for haircuts. Thank you so much, five stars definitely!

After moving to the neighborhood we were in search for a new groomer for our 2 boys. We came across Palace Pet grooming driving to Starbucks. They are wonderful. They really care for your dog and ask questions on how you would like your dogs hair cut to be and what services you would like. Not to mention their prices are great!! We feel very comfortable dropping off our boys and knowing they are in good hands. The owners are so nice and welcoming. I highly recommend Palace Pet grooming.
Every time my dog goes to his grooming he comes home happy. Thank you for your service

I was very upset I specifically asked first a teddy bear look and showed them pictures and explained and they kept saying yes yes and that they knew what I meant and then they cut her like a poodle and that is what I said I did not want ! And also her nails were supposed to be cut and they were still pretty long and hurting me when she scratched I am but taking her here any more for my puppy s grooming needs
Excellent service and attention to our dogs! It's a center of pure love and care. I love that they leave my dogs beautiful and happy. 100% recommend, and the prices are excellent! 😊🙏🥰 …
Very good work and dedication 💯 Recommended …
Great work!!

The worst. Had an appointment for 11:45 for the first time and was told “ yeah it’s gonna be a few hours” WHAT?! What’s the point of an appointment and to lock my puppy in a cage for God knows how long! 00000

This is a fantastic spot for getting your little pups groomed! The staff was efficient, clean, and incredibly friendly. What I appreciated most was that they didn’t keep my dogs waiting for hours—dropped them off at 9 a.m., and they were ready by 11! They really take the time to understand your pups’ needs, which made the whole experience even better. Overall, just a great visit. This is definitely my new go-to grooming place!

The best pet service in the area; I've been taking my pet (Tomás) there for several years and my experience has been 5 stars. The service from Mrs. Esther and Mr. Álvaro is second to none, which is why I highly recommend them.
Excellent

Great service and they're really nice. They treat my Bailey like a princess.
Thanks Dennys for giving us full stars. Always welcome.

Excellent service, the owners take care of every pet like family… they and the amazing team really care for our special family members… 10 from 5 starts … they handle with care my  4 pounds mini poodle ( she is not easy jeee)..  I love palace .
My dog always come back fresh and full of joy! She still smells great after 2 weeks! She likes being there overall. Staff is very attentive.

They keep pets in cages for extended periods and cannot schedule specific grooming times for each dog. As a result, your dog may end up waiting in a cage for hours both before and after grooming. Additionally they are quite rude.
This place is great!!  I have been taking my poodle every 3 weeks for grooming for years now. The owners are super nice and the place is very clean. Highly recommend them.
Great place to bring your dog to get groomed. The best!! Thank you for always making  Ceasar look great!!

Love this place! Very caring staff and my dogs always come out happy.
They always do a decent job with my pups
Excellent place for pets, very friendly and professional. Highly recommended for quality of services and reasonable prices.
My favorite place for my dogs they do a great job!!

My name is Yairin and my dog's name is Santi. We're always very happy with the bathing and grooming service and the attention from the lady and gentleman who always greet us. I recommend this place 100%! I give it 5 stars 🤩 but I would really give it more! Thank you so much to Palace Pet Grooming! …
Today Luna again with her Christmas Luck thanks once again to PALACE PET GROOMING..!!!!
We are always very happy with Luna's haircut and the overall service they provide, so we recommend this place 100%. Thank you so much for your services!

Good customer service as well as reasonable pricing and service. I recommend it. The only thing to consider is that they do not have a set closing time and once they have finished with your pet, they’ll give you an hour or so to pick them up. This might be an issue with busy pet parents that have a hectic schedule. Other than that, my experience has been good!
They SHAVED my golden retriever!!! How do they do this!?!? What professional dog groomer doesn’t know that you’re not supposed to shave them!!!???
This was my 1st time taking my little Morkie , the staff was so nice  and  I was super happy  the services we definitely will be back.

Very pleasant and attentive to customers. I especially enjoyed how nice the owners were and took good care of my puppy. Very clean environment and smelled just as nice! I was recommended by someone and after this experience I will be returning again! Thank you so much!!

I love this place! $40 for a sanitation cut, they cut my yorkie hair and cut her nails and bathed her and gave her a cute design and I couldn’t be happier they are very good at what they do and I trust them with my yorkie anytime !
